# Icon + Text

`features/icon-text` &middot; content-level &middot; category: features

## Purpose

An icon on the left with a title and short description on the right, on one row.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | image { src, alt } |  |
| `title` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: 40px icon beside the text.
- **large**: A 56px icon. Sets `iconSize: 56px`.
- **round**: Circular icon crop (square in Outlook desktop). Sets `iconRadius: 50%`.
- **centered**: Icon vertically centered against the text. Sets `valign: middle`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `iconSize` | length | `"40px"` |
| `iconRadius` | length | `"0"` |
| `gap` | length | `"@spacing.md"` |
| `valign` | one of `top`, `middle`, `bottom` | `"top"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"0 0 @spacing.md 0"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Table cells and images honored. | Fine. Cells stay side by side on phones, keep text short. | Text swaps via dm-* classes where honored. Icons are not recolored. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('features/icon-text', {
  "icon": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/80x80/png?text=%E2%9C%93",
    "alt": "",
    "decorative": true
  },
  "title": "Free returns for 60 days",
  "description": "Changed your mind? Send it back, we cover the postage."
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "features/icon-text",
  "data": {
    "icon": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/80x80/png?text=%E2%9C%93",
      "alt": "",
      "decorative": true
    },
    "title": "Free returns for 60 days",
    "description": "Changed your mind? Send it back, we cover the postage."
  }
}
```
